_comment: Bluesky is the live source and needs no token — just the account handle (e.g. 'benditofantasy.bsky.social', or a custom-domain handle). Threads/Instagram are optional: fill their numeric user IDs (from the Meta Graph API Explorer) and set THREADS_ACCESS_TOKEN / IG_ACCESS_TOKEN env vars (repo secrets in CI) to enable them. Leave any field blank to skip that platform.
siteDomains_comment: Posts linking to any of these domains are skipped as self-promo (we post our own article links to spread the word; surfacing them here would loop). Add every domain the site is served from.
specialRouting_comment: Posts whose text carries one of these hashtags (case-insensitive) file into the special row instead of the latest gameweek. Remove an entry when its special is retired.
